title: Towards culturally-appropriate conversational AI for health in the majority world: An exploratory study with citizens and professionals in Latin America

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative participatory workshops using projective storytelling and interactions with a persona-customized LLM (GPT-3.5) to identify cultural misalignment, contextual disconnects, and regional appropriateness in AI health conversations.

Reflexive inductive thematic analysis of participant discussions highlighting how AI health recommendations often fail to account for local logistical limitations, financial constraints, physical infrastructure, and resource availability in Latin American contexts.
